name.en: Fio Puro Black Cropped Wool Jacket with a Zip Front, a Short Hem and a Small Collar
name.pt-BR: Jaqueta cropped Fio Puro preta de lã, zíper na frente, barra curta e gola pequena

description.en: A black cropped wool jacket with a zip and a hem that ends at the hip. It layers over a high rise without covering the waist.
description.pt-BR: Jaqueta cropped preta de lã, zíper e barra no quadril. Entra sobre um cós alto sem cobrir a cintura.
